acceptanceCriteria: Shared pitch identity and frequency calculations cover named pitches, direct frequencies, reference adjustment, and transposition.
Equal divisions, ratios, cents, and explicit-frequency tuning models resolve deterministically within approved bounds.
Pitch and tuning calculations meet the ±0.1-cent accuracy requirement with boundary tests.
The shared domain is usable unchanged by iPhone and Watch targets.
rationale: All playback and profile behavior depends on deterministic shared musical mathematics.
testSteps: Run calculation, boundary, enharmonic, transposition, and tuning-model unit tests.
Verify identical shared-domain behavior from iPhone and Watch test hosts.

workItem.title: Implement pitch, tuning, and temperament domain engine
